scope: Draft teacher-objective diagnosis on revised offline sampling; no online gate or checkpoint selection
mean_denominator: Equal weights for all 8 registered days; each includes all 4 states and zero ineligible objective weights
eligibility: Predeclared teacher objective eligibility and legal future token support; all ineligible states still recorded
expected_good_direction: I3 minus each control risk/regret negative; descriptive, does not replace online gate
limits: Warmstart and decoding pools have seen the 200 history days. Fixed cond_hist infinite-time teachers are not optimal or deployment-10s trajectories. Multiple diagnostic comparisons are exploratory.
